title: A Dictionary of the Kachin Language (1906 / 1954)
title_english: A Dictionary of the Kachin Language (1906 / 1954)
title_tai: ပပ်ႉ သပ်ႉဒါ ၵႂၢမ်း ၶၢင် လႄႈ တႆး
author: Rev. Ola Hanson, Litt.D.
category: American Baptist Mission & PAHAR Master Editions
provenance: Rangoon: Baptist Board of Publications / PAHAR (dli.pahar.3005)
description: Monumental lexicographical masterpiece by missionary-linguist Dr. Ola Hanson. Compiles over 12,000 lexical entries of the Jinghpaw (Kachin) and Singpho language spoken along the Upper Irrawaddy and Patkai borderlands. Contains extensive comparative cross-references to Southwestern Tai (Shan, Khamti, and Khamyang) loanwords, reflecting centuries of trade, intermarriage, and bilingualism between the Tai and Jinghpaw-Singpho peoples.
